claims.claim: Amazon is offering a new developer track at unBoxed 2026 that includes technical breakout sessions, workshops, and a hackathon.
claims.quote: Join our new developer track at unBoxed 2026 for technical breakout sessions, workshops, a hackathon, and more.

claims.claim: The Amazon Ads MCP server is in open beta.
claims.quote: Our Amazon Ads MCP server is now in open beta.

claims.claim: The new Amazon Ads reporting API is in open beta.
The new Amazon Ads reporting API offers multi-dimensional, cross-account, and cross ad-product reporting with standardized metrics for ad-hoc use cases.
claims.quote: Our new reporting API offers multi-dimensional, cross-account, and cross ad-product reporting with standardized metrics for ad-hoc use cases.

claims.claim: Amazon Ads offers technology solutions to help companies scale, manage, and report on their advertising activities.
claims.quote: Amazon Ads offers technology solutions to help you scale, manage, and report on your advertising activities.

claims.claim: The Amazon Ads API enables programmatic management and reporting of Amazon Ads campaigns.
claims.quote: Manage and report on Amazon Ads campaigns programmatically through our API.

claims.claim: Bulksheets is a spreadsheet-based tool used to manage sponsored ads campaigns.
claims.quote: Use bulksheets, a spreadsheet-based tool, to manage sponsored ads campaigns.

claims.claim: Amazon Marketing Stream provides hourly campaign metrics and notifications of campaign changes in near real time.
claims.quote: Get hourly campaign metrics and notifications of campaign changes in near real time.

claims.claim: Amazon Marketing Cloud enables analytics and audience building across pseudonymized signals to address marketing and business priorities.
claims.quote: Perform analytics and build audiences across pseudonymized signals to address top marketing and business priorities.

claims.claim: The campaign management API in the new Amazon Ads API v1 creates campaigns across different ad products using a consistent campaign model.
claims.quote: Use the new campaign management API to create campaigns across different ad products using a consistent campaign model.

claims.claim: Export APIs provide campaign management information in a common model and format across sponsored ads products.
claims.quote: Export APIs offer campaign management information in a common model and format across sponsored ads products.

claims.claim: Export APIs will replace the deprecated snapshots APIs.
claims.quote: Export APIs will replace the deprecated snapshots APIs.

claims.claim: The Amazon Ads API integration dashboard is used to monitor and manage Amazon Ads API integrations.
claims.quote: Monitor and better manage your Amazon Ads API integration.

claims.claim: Amazon provides a series of eight bulksheets video tutorials with guidelines and tips for success.
claims.quote: A series of eight video tutorials with guidelines and tips for success.

claims.claim: The Amazon Ads API global expansion guide is designed to help integrators expand their advertising to new locales.
claims.quote: A guide designed to help integrators expand their advertising to new locales.

claims.claim: The advanced tools guide introduces Amazon Ads advanced tools to help scale businesses.
claims.quote: A guide to introduce you to Amazon Ads advanced tools to help scale your business.

claims.claim: Amazon provides a guide to help advertisers consider new opportunities to further their technological capabilities with the Amazon Ads API.
claims.quote: This guide will help you consider new opportunities to further your technological capabilities with the Amazon Ads API.
